thread.title: Apple announces red iPhone 8 and 8 Plus models; phones begin shipping Friday

author: Emily Bary
title: Apple announces red iPhone 8 and 8 Plus models; phones begin shipping Friday
text: Apple Inc. AAPL, +1.94% said Monday that it would be launching red versions of the iPhone 8 and 8 Plus. The new red models, part of Apple's Product(RED) collection, will be available for preorder starting Tuesday, April 10, and they'll go on sale beginning Friday, April 13. Apple has been making Product(RED) devices since 2006, and donates a portion of sales from these products to help provide HIV/AIDS testing, counseling, and treatment. The iPhone 8 starts at $699 and the iPhone 8 Plus starts at $799. Apple shares are up 1.7% in Monday trading and up 19% over the past 12 months. The Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +1.14% of which Apple is a component, is up 17% in that time.
